$comment: Self-healing locators rubric config — pilot-ready example shaped after a CRM-platform pilot (Creatio-style UI). IMPORTANT: all paths in this file are resolved RELATIVE TO THE CONFIG FILE for projectDir, and RELATIVE TO projectDir for everything else. CANONICAL location: copy to <Project>/UI-Automation/rubric.config.json and SET projectDir FOR YOUR LOCATION ('.' when the config sits next to the artefacts) — this name is auto-found without --config and gitignored (real creds). `$comment` keys are ignored everywhere.

auth.$comment: mode 'api' = POST auth.url, cookies land in the browser context (Creatio AuthService pattern); Supervisor/Supervisor are public test-stand creds — OK in this example, real project creds belong in a gitignored copy. userField/passwordField default to UserName/UserPassword. mode 'none' = skip auth.

$comment-allowlist: R0 guard is DEFAULT-DENY: every file under projectDir is checksummed at loop start EXCEPT those matching this allowlist (the only files the FIXER may edit) and the rubric's own baselineDir/verdictsDir. Any changed/deleted/NEW file outside the allowlist = abort. Globs relative to projectDir; a pattern without '/' matches at any depth.
$comment-offLimits: Extra EXPLICIT protection on top of default-deny: files matching these globs are guarded EVEN IF they also match the allowlist. Use to pin especially sensitive files.
$comment-testCommand: R3 — full Playwright suite command run from projectDir, e.g. 'npx playwright test'. null = R3 reported as skipped (not failed) — the pilot had locator artefacts but no spec suite yet.

readySelectors.$comment: URL-substring -> element to await before counting locators (Freedom UI renders 10-15s after networkidle). First matching substring wins; no match = settleMs wait only.

$comment-preAuthGroups: Groups verified BEFORE the API login (the login form redirects to Shell once authenticated).

urlOverrides.$comment: R1 page mapping per '<file>#<topLevelGroup>'. Missing entry -> the group's own 'url' field is used if placeholder-free; explicit null -> group skipped-with-notice (e.g. form pages needing a record GUID — paste a real edit URL like /0/Shell/#Card/Products_FormPage/edit/<GUID> to enable them; modal groups need a click, direct hash-modal URLs MAY work: /0/Shell/#Section/Products_ListPage[modal=Products_MiniPage/add]).

samples.$comment: Placeholder -> sample value for template locators containing <...>. Keys must match the placeholder EXACTLY, including angle brackets. Values below use the demo records noted in the project's own LOCATORS.md.

$comment-multiAllowed: Entry ids ('<file>#<keyPath>', '*' wildcard allowed) where matching MORE than one element still passes R1 (count >= 1) — e.g. one record link per grid row. Everything else must resolve to EXACTLY ONE element.
